sloka: अयुद्ध्यत तदा वाली शक्रतुल्यपराक्रमः ।मुष्टिभिर्जानुभिश्चैव शिलाभिः पादपैस्तथा ॥४-११-४३॥।।
transliteration: ayuddhyata tadā vālī śakratulyaparākramaḥ ।muṣṭibhirjānubhiścaiva śilābhiḥ pādapaistathā ॥4-11-43॥।।

translations.english: 'Then Vali who was equal to Indra in prowess fought, hitting him with fists, knees, rocks and trees.
